description: Payload published by the orchestrator (AgentQueueService) to tasks_developer|tasks_tester|tasks_devops.

execution_id.description: agent_executions row created by the orchestrator before dispatch; the worker echoes it back on /report.

attempt.description: Attempt number for this task+agent pair, computed by the orchestrator.

branch.description: Dedicated git branch for this task, e.g. agent/task-123.

project_source_type.description: Defaults to 'local' so tasks queued before this field existed keep behaving like today.

project_repository_ssh_key_path.description: Only the path to a key already on the worker host; the worker never receives the key's content.

repository_credential_token.description: One-time token exchanged at /worker/credential (purpose=repository_password) for the real HTTPS username/password.
